info.description: Development simulation only. X-Demo-* headers select a demo session and are not authentication. The default runtime is synthetic; the local API can optionally execute governed text-model requests through LiteLLM. See docs/api.md for the production adapter boundary. Includes normalized inventory/usage imports, dictionary inspection, workflow authority, evidence custody, policy distribution and assurance lifecycle commands.
